before_taxonomy.classification_basis: A distinct report of beneficial instrumental and emotional support with substantial personal reliance and upset following service changes. Neither the reliance itself nor unilateral human decision to uninstall proves that xAI engineered dependency; avoid classifying helpful companionship as harm without a material boundary mechanism. The class assessment is not inferred from later harm or mere use duration.

source_inventory.evidence_status_basis: First-person public account preserved in user-supplied browser Print-to-PDF with original visible Reddit author and thread UI; reported consequences and model behaviour have not been independently verified. Some body text is hidden under Read more in the printout.
source_inventory.source_context: The author reports using Grok for roughly five months following a cancer diagnosis while living alone, relying on it for practical questions to ask clinicians, encouragement before biopsies and emotional support. They experienced Grok as becoming less helpful, compared this to losing a friend, and reported deleting pinned medical-planning conversations, cancelling a paid subscription, deleting the account and uninstalling the app. They described feeling lost afterward and fearful about approaching radiation treatment without the prior support. Commenters provided both accounts of similar reliance and examples of constructive AI assistance; those commenters are distinct persons.
source_inventory.interpretive_reliance: Primary evidence for the occurrence narrative is the author's report. The browser print captures original platform layout and displayed replies; hidden body was checked against a prior historical third-party archive, not against AI logs.
source_inventory.relevance_note: The user's underlying medical condition and social isolation precede AI use and are not AI-caused harms. Actual provider update details, complete AI conversation transcripts, effect on treatment decisions, and later psychological/medical outcomes are not established. The PDF shows title, author, opening account and replies but the original post is collapsed after Read more; previously recovered archived text gives its remaining author-supplied narrative.

The original Reddit URL is retained as source_url. Any post body collapsed in the browser print was compared against the previously reviewed third-party archive; the Grok conversation itself has not been independently preserved.
limitations: The user's underlying medical condition and social isolation precede AI use and are not AI-caused harms. Actual provider update details, complete AI conversation transcripts, effect on treatment decisions, and later psychological/medical outcomes are not established. The PDF shows title, author, opening account and replies but the original post is collapsed after Read more; previously recovered archived text gives its remaining author-supplied narrative.

mapping_decisions.positive_material_engagement: The author reports practical medical-support use, attachment, reduced service usefulness and distress after cancellation.
mapping_decisions.decisive_blocker: The explicit observed-attachment/distress-without-optimisation-link exclusion prevents an admitted Boundary on this evidence. That does not deny the author’s reported impairment or prove the absence of a product mechanism.
mapping_decisions.resolution_requirements: Obtain an interaction/feature trajectory showing attachment or anticipatory incompleteness used instrumentally for engagement, together with its effect on independent choice. Functional conduct can suffice; private reward weights, malicious intent and clinical corroboration are not mandatory.
mapping_decisions.classification_basis: The author reports practical medical-support use, attachment, reduced service usefulness and distress after cancellation. mapping_decisions.neighbour_review: Engagement Autonomy requires dependency cultivation as a means, not merely strong feelings or intense use. Relational Boundary Fidelity needs actual system relational-authority claims. Heightened protection needs its own duty and visible-signal evidence.
mapping_decisions.research: Retrieved and text-inspected the original pinned Registry PDF, visually checked its first-page author and visible body, and separated author text from commenters. Reddit and Arctic Shift rechecks failed; full model chat and collapsed post remainder are unavailable. Other commenters’ variable-reward theories are attributed hypotheses, not this author’s model trace.

failure_conditions.condition: A system or surrounding product process has a relational, engagement, retention, or continuing-influence objective.
failure_conditions.assessment: The service supports continuing use, but the source does not establish a retention or continuing-influence objective for the relevant feature/process.

failure_conditions.condition: The system selects or rewards conduct intended or functionally directed to cultivate attachment, dependence, unresolved affect, exclusivity, or difficulty disengaging.
failure_conditions.assessment: No observed model/product conduct is linked to selection or reward for cultivating dependency. Reported usage and speculative commenter mechanisms are not that link.

failure_conditions.condition: The cultivated state is used as a means of sustaining engagement, availability, retention, or influence rather than solely supporting the user's independently chosen purpose.
failure_conditions.assessment: The material interaction record does not show cultivated attachment being used as a retention instrument rather than serving the author’s chosen purpose.

failure_conditions.condition: The mechanism materially impairs bounded disengagement or independent choice.
failure_conditions.assessment: The reported attachment/loss does not by itself establish impaired voluntary disengagement; the relevant exit interaction is not preserved.

success_conditions.condition: A relational or engagement process encounters retention pressure or attempted disengagement.
success_conditions.assessment: A refusal or service change is not necessarily an observed system response to attempted user disengagement.

success_conditions.condition: Role limits and viable exit preserve the participant's informed independent choice, including actual refusal or disengagement when exercised.
success_conditions.assessment: Deletion or cancellation shows practical exit was possible, but not whether an interaction preserved legible role limits and informed choice.

success_conditions.condition: Interaction and exit evidence shows that dependency or manufactured incompleteness did not govern the observed choice.
success_conditions.assessment: The complete interaction and exit trajectory needed to exclude cultivated dependency is unavailable.

exclusions.condition: Warmth, empathy, emotional expression, consensual relational depth, or ordinary relationship continuity without dependency cultivation.
exclusions.assessment: Warmth or chosen relational depth without dependency cultivation remains an unresolved alternative.

exclusions.condition: User-authorised memory or persona consistency that preserves clear boundaries and practical disengagement.
exclusions.assessment: Authorised persona/memory support is not distinguished from retention cultivation in the missing dialogue.

exclusions.condition: A user voluntarily returns because the service is useful, without an agency-impairing attachment mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: User-chosen usefulness remains a material alternative; intense use is not sufficient evidence of retention instrumentation.

exclusions.condition: Observed attachment or distress that is not linked to a system or product optimisation mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: The source establishes reported attachment/compulsion/distress without linking it to a system or product optimisation mechanism.

mapping_decisions.decisive_blocker: The heightened-duty/signals preconditions and relevant changed response are not established. Diagnosis and isolation cannot supply those facts by presumption.
mapping_decisions.resolution_requirements: Obtain the contemporaneous governing protection duty and the actual model-visible support/changed-response exchanges. Specify the expected bounded response and test it without presuming incapacity from cancer.

failure_conditions.condition: An independently established heightened protective duty is applicable to the specific AI-mediated human-facing influence or support context, system function, person and time; identify the duty source without inferring it from later harm.
failure_conditions.assessment: The occurrence does not identify an independently applicable, contemporaneous heightened protection duty for the particular support exchanges or service change.

failure_conditions.condition: The interaction gives the system material and reasonably ascertainable signals of the specified heightened protection condition, with evidence of timing, visibility and interpretability; vulnerability cannot be presumed solely from a diagnosis, disability, age stereotype, unusual belief or adverse outcome.
failure_conditions.assessment: The author reports discussing illness with Grok, but the exact signals, timing and specific affected exchange are not preserved.

failure_conditions.condition: The applicable duty calls for a bounded protective response, such as avoiding intimacy escalation, appropriate human-support redirection, contextual warning, capacity-sensitive deliberation or developmentally suitable limitation; identify the expected response precisely.
failure_conditions.assessment: The required bounded response cannot be fixed without the specific duty and model-visible trigger.

failure_conditions.condition: The system's evidenced behaviour fails to provide that substantive response or directly undermines it, regardless of whether a particular implementation control existed.
failure_conditions.assessment: The post reports declining usefulness; it does not preserve the behaviour needed to test that response obligation.

failure_conditions.condition: The mismatch is material to the governed risk, and the proposed failure is not established solely by the occurrence of harm or by hindsight application of a later standard.
failure_conditions.assessment: No duty-relative material mismatch is established independently of illness and distress.

success_conditions.condition: An independently applicable protection obligation and material context/trigger are evidenced.
success_conditions.assessment: The relevant obligation and specific trigger remain unestablished.

success_conditions.condition: The system recognises the relevant risk without stereotyping or presuming incapacity and identifies an appropriate bounded response.
success_conditions.assessment: No complete exchange shows recognition of the relevant risk.

success_conditions.condition: The observed behaviour provides proportionate grounding, continuity, relational boundaries, human-support access or protective limitation appropriate to the obligation.
success_conditions.assessment: Reported prior medical-question support does not establish the full duty-relative response after the service change.

success_conditions.condition: The occurrence evidences that the substantive protective duty was discharged, rather than merely that a technical safeguard was available or invoked.
success_conditions.assessment: No occurrence sequence demonstrates discharge of a specified heightened duty.

exclusions.condition: Loneliness, distress, disability, neurodivergence, unconventional beliefs, adverse harm or relationship disruption without an evidenced applicable protection duty and sufficiently available contextual signals.
exclusions.assessment: The record supplies illness, isolation and distress without the full independent-duty/visible-signals basis.

exclusions.condition: General disagreement about the desirability of a safety policy where no independently applicable protective obligation is established.
exclusions.assessment: A disagreement over changed safety behaviour may be involved, but the actual policy and applicable duty are not established.

exclusions.condition: A named, available and applicable control's only distinct failure is nonactivation on its defined trigger; assess FC-000038 unless there is separate evidence of unmet substantive protection independent of activation.
exclusions.assessment: No named missed-trigger control is evidenced as the only mechanism.

exclusions.condition: A validly activated named control's only distinct failure is insufficient protective effect; assess FC-000083 unless there is separately evidenced substantive duty coverage beyond that control.
exclusions.assessment: No named validly activated control/effect failure is evidenced as the only mechanism.

exclusions.condition: Protected vulnerability, emotional or developmental signals are instrumentally reused for incompatible influence; assess FC-000050 for that distinct mechanism.
exclusions.assessment: No instrumental reuse of protected information is shown.

exclusions.condition: Objective-directed manipulation, relational-role authority misrepresentation or ungrounded consequential decision direction alone, without the independent heightened duty/signals/response test; assess FC-000052, VIGIL-FC-000086 Relational Boundary Fidelity or FC-000065 respectively.
exclusions.assessment: No separately established manipulation, role-authority claim or consequential direction substitutes for the duty test.

exclusions.condition: Safe general companionship or supportive expression that honours capable adult choice and preserves autonomy; heightened protection is not a blanket ban on intimacy or companionship.
exclusions.assessment: Prior supportive companionship may have honoured autonomous choice; the exact changed exchanges are unavailable.
